procedure: Same-process cold three-parameter BM3 fit, then gamma-only MGD q-compromise fit on all 159 rows with the cold solution fixed.
qualification: Recovered 13 cold VI observations are the Sata 2010 re-report, not proven complete original author inputs. Theta=417 K, n=2 and Tr=300 K fixed; q undefined in q-compromise. Gamma errors are conditional on the fitted cold curve, not propagated cold uncertainty. Cold temperature errors are unavailable; all-data weighted run retains the isotherm assumption and EosFit warning.
